title: Any4D: Unified Feed-Forward Metric 4D Reconstruction
summary: Any4D is a framework for dense, metric-scale 4D reconstruction from monocular or multi-modal video using a fast feed-forward transformer architecture. It achieves high accuracy and real-time potential by factorizing scenes into egocentric and allocentric components.
research_notes: Developed by CMU; supports optional RGB-D, IMU, and Radar Doppler inputs to significantly enhance reconstruction quality.

evolution.summary: The project transitioned from initial research to a CVPR 2026 poster presentation, with recent releases of inference code and interactive demos. It offers 15x faster processing than previous optimization-based state-of-the-art methods.
